salary: 150,000 Negotiable Role Summary Are you passionate about data and eager to be part of a rapidly growing company at the forefront of technology? If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you. Our client is a dynamic and diversified group of companies specialising in distribution,ship supply, retail, and wholesale operations. We are seeking a talented Data Engineer (Azure Databricks) to join our expanding Technology Team. The successful candidate will be based in either Kigali, Rwanda or Nairobi, Kenya, supporting our African operations and Group-wide data initiatives. As part of our digital transformation journey, we are building a modern enterprise data platform. Our current landscape includes Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, Microsoft Dynamics NAV, MuleSoft integration services, Azure technologies, and Power BI analytics solutions. We are currently implementing an Azure Databricks Lakehouse platform to create a scalable, governed, and future-ready data ecosystem. This role presents an exciting opportunity to help shape and develop the next generation of our enterprise data platform. Duties and Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines using Azure Databricks. Build and manage data ingestion processes from ERP, sales, logistics, finance, warehouse, and external systems Develop and maintain Lakehouse data architectures following Medallion principles (Bronze, Silver, Gold). Create robust ETL/ELT processes using Databricks, PySpark, SQL, and Azure services. Implement data quality, validation, monitoring, and governance processes. Develop and maintain dimensional data models to support business intelligence and reporting requirements. Work closely with Business Analysts, BI Developers, and Business Stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable data solutions. Optimise data processing workloads for performance, reliability, and cost efficiency. Support real-time and batch data processing initiatives. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and adoption of modern data engineering best practices. Essential Skills and Experience Experience working in a Data Engineering role. Strong knowledge of SQL and relational databases. Experience developing ETL/ELT pipelines. Experience with Azure Databricks, Spark, or similar cloud-based data platforms. Strong programming skills using Python and/or PySpark. Experience designing and implementing data models and data warehouse solutions. Knowledge of data governance, data quality, and master data management principles. Experience integrating data from multiple systems and APIs. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Ability to work independently while remaining a collaborative team player. Desirable Skills Microsoft Azure Data Services. Delta Lake and Unity Catalog. Azure Data Factory. Power BI and analytics platforms. MuleSoft integrations. Experience with Microsoft Dynamics Business Central or NAV. Databricks Certifications. Azure Data Engineer Associate Certification (DP-203). What We Offer Opportunity to work on a modern Azure Databricks Lakehouse implementation. Exposure to large-scale distribution, retail, logistics, and supply chain datasets. International project exposure across multiple African and European markets. Professional growth within a well-established and rapidly evolving organisation. Collaborative and innovative work environment. Competitive remuneration package and benefits.

Prepare budget-versus-actual reports and variance analysis for management and Project Managers. Provide financial information for management, donor, Board and audit reporting. Analyze project expenditure, burn rates, forecasts, and financial performance. Develop and maintain financial dashboards and management reports where required. Provide timely financial information to support program decision-making. 5. Financial Controls and Risk Management Ensure effective financial controls are implemented across projects and organizational operations. Monitor compliance with financial policies, procedures, and delegated authorities. Identify financial, fraud and compliance risks and recommend appropriate mitigation measures. Ensure proper segregation of duties and adequate supporting documentation. Follow up financial control weaknesses and audit recommendations. Promote accountability, transparency, and value for money across all projects. 6. Partner Financial Management Where projects are implemented through partners: Participate in financial due diligence and capacity assessments of implementing partners. Review partner budgets and financial reports. Monitor partner expenditure and advances. Conduct financial monitoring and spot checks as required. Accounting and Treasury Oversight Oversee accounts payable, accounts receivable, and general ledger processes. Ensure accurate and complete financial records and audit trails are maintained. 8. Statutory Compliance Ensure timely preparation, reconciliation and submission of applicable statutory returns and payments, including PAYE, NSSF, SHIF, VAT, withholding tax and instalment tax. Liaise with relevant statutory authorities to resolve financial and tax matters. Monitor changes in relevant financial and tax requirements and advise management accordingly. 9. Audit and Project Close-Out Coordinate project and organizational financial audits. Prepare audit schedules and support documentation. Respond to audit queries and follow up on implementation of audit recommendations. Lead the financial aspects of project close-out, including reconciliation of expenditure, advances, assets, commitments and final donor financial reports. Ensure project financial records are complete and properly archived. 10. Capacity Building and Financial Business Partnering Build the financial management capacity of Project Managers and program staff. Train non-finance staff on budgeting, financial procedures, donor compliance, and budget monitoring. Support program teams to understand and use financial information for decision-making. Promote a culture of financial accountability across the organization. Identify opportunities to improve financial systems, processes, reporting, and automation. Strong knowledge of Kenyan statutory and tax requirements. Experience in financial audits, internal controls, and risk management. Strong Excel, financial analysis skills, and experience using accounting/ERP systems.

Position Overview We are seeking a highly detail-oriented and technically strong Multi-Sensor LiDAR Labeling Operations Policy & Quality Expert to support labeling policy development, quality management, and operational excellence across autonomous vehicle (AV) data annotation programs. The role involves working with LiDAR, camera, radar, and sensor-fusion annotation workflows to define clear annotation standards, improve labeling quality, and support the development of high-quality datasets for autonomous driving systems. Key Responsibilities Develop, maintain, and update annotation policies for 3D LiDAR object labeling, multi-sensor fusion, camera-LiDAR alignment, radar-assisted labeling, semantic segmentation, tracking, temporal consistency, and trajectory annotation. Design and support QA processes, including golden tasks, reviewer calibration, and inter-annotator agreement. Conduct quality audits, identify recurring labeling issues, and drive corrective actions. Analyze annotation productivity, ambiguity trends, and policy gaps. Support workforce onboarding, certification, and calibration programs. Collaborate with labeling vendors and BPO partners to implement annotation policies. Work with perception, ML, tooling, and program teams to improve annotation quality and consistency. Support dataset launches, quality reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives. Key Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Robotics, Data Science, GIS, or a related field. 5+ years of experience in autonomous vehicle data annotation, LiDAR labeling operations, quality assurance, or annotation policy development. Strong understanding of 3D point cloud data, sensor fusion systems, object tracking, trajectory labeling, and AV perception pipelines. Experience working with annotation tools supporting LiDAR, multi-camera systems, radar, or HD maps. Proven experience managing annotation quality at scale. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent documentation and stakeholder communication skills. Ability to work effectively with technical, operational, and vendor teams. A must have to be considered: A working personal laptop (Please note this will be verified while shortlisting) An internet connection of 15 MBPS and above Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis therefore the sooner you apply the better. job_title: Information technology, software development, data Jobs for Senior-level in Kenya
company: Description You will build software that safely and securely moves billions of dollars to millions of vulnerable people in some of the poorest and highest need parts of the world. This will require applying excellent engineering, team building and organizational judgment to complex, high-stakes operations: identity and fraud management, machine learning on large but imperfect datasets (cell phone data, satellite imagery, government registries), mobile money integrations, low-connectivity environments, rapidly evolving requirements all in diverse regulatory environments and country contexts. You’ll need to keep our legacy technology stack stable and performant, while in parallel building new systems from the ground up for our next level of scale. You will lead engineering, data, security and enterprise technology – with a small, mighty and rapidly growing engineering team of ~15, and the expectation that this can at least double to ~30 in the next 12 months if you want it to. You’ll report to a CEO with deep experience running technology companies, and partner with our VP Product. What we’re looking for: An exceptional hirer, manager and organizer of technical talent. Proven record identifying, hiring, developing and retaining excellent engineers and engineering leaders, and creating team processes that consistently deliver software with quality and velocity. Deep technical judgment, applied close to the work. You can evaluate major designs, pressure-test architecture and build-vs-buy decisions, and recognize when a team is heading the wrong way, without becoming the primary implementer. Low-ego: you’ll investigate a problem yourself when that’s what the situation requires. Business judgment and decisiveness under ambiguity. You’re not just a technical leader, you’re also a business executive. You understand the business, are a strong cross-functional partner, and have a history of good judgment when navigating tradeoffs of long vs. short term, speed, reliability, security, flexibility, cost, technical quality, and user impact. AI first. You have a point of view on where AI meaningfully changes engineering productivity and organizational capability, and you’ve moved a team from experimentation to real, measured use. You can set the tools, culture, goals, and guardrails that leverage the opportunities and mitigate the risks of an AI first engineering culture. Embody and set an example for GD values. We take our values incredibly seriously, and expect our leaders to embody, nurture, and promote them in the way they work and the teams they build. Advantages, not requirements. Experience in an operationally complex or regulated domain (fintech, payments, humanitarian response, global development); systems involving financial controls, fraud risk, identity, or sensitive recipient data; operating across multiple countries, particularly lower-income or infrastructure-constrained ones; leading both modern product engineering and enterprise technology. What you’ll do Define our technology vision and target stack. Own the technical strategy for technology-first delivery at $5B+/year: architecture, platforms, build-vs-buy, and what we retire. Work with executive, product, finance, risk, and data leaders to turn program and product strategy into a sequenced, credible portfolio of technical investments. Balance a demanding portfolio. You’ll manage six workstreams that all matter and won’t all move at once: (1) building our new cash delivery stack (remote-first verification, fraud prevention, massive volume) (2) stabilizing our legacy stack until switchover, then managing the migration; (3) donor-facing fundraising products; (4) our global emergency cash system (and eventual white-labelling of that product); (5) enterprise technology; (6) internal tooling, platform, and cybersecurity. Deciding sequencing and staffing across these (and saying “not yet” credibly) is the job. Build and grow an exceptional technology organization. Recruit outstanding engineering and technology talent, design the org GiveDirectly needs at its next stage of scale (engineering, product, data, security, infrastructure, enterprise systems), and create the accountability, decision rights, and career paths to sustain high talent density. Grow the engineering team from 15 to ~30 with a lean but durable management structure. Own the technical direction and quality bar. Guide consequential decisions on integrations, data, security, reliability, and technical debt. Technical Evaluation of Electrical Equipment • Understand and evaluate the technical capacity, ratings, and specifications of MV panels/switchgear (11kV/33kV VCB, RMU), LV panels (MCCB/ACB distribution boards), and power/distribution transformers (dry-type and oil-filled). • Assess vendor technical offers against project specifications, IEC/BS/KS (KEBS) standards, and approved benchmark equipment, flagging non-compliances. • Support selection of lighting fixtures based on lux level requirements, IP/IK ratings, lumen output, and compliance with the project's Schedule of Light Fittings. • Apply correct cable selection principles — sizing based on current rating, voltage drop, derating factors, cable type (XLPE/PVC, armoured/unarmoured), and application (LV/MV, fire-rated, control). • Prepare and maintain technical compliance/comparison workbooks (vendor-vs-approved benchmark) for panels, transformers, cables, and lighting submissions. 3. Procurement, Vendor Management & Negotiation • Source and shortlist vendors/manufacturers for electrical materials and equipment (panels, transformers, cables, lighting, accessories) locally and internationally (India, China, UAE, South Africa, Europe). • Issue RFQs/enquiries, collect and technically screen vendor quotations, and prepare vendor comparison summaries for management/MD approval. • Negotiate pricing, payment terms, lead times, and warranty/after-sales terms directly with vendors and suppliers to achieve best commercial value without compromising technical compliance. • Track and evaluate vendor performance, certification validity (type-test certificates, PVOC, ISO), and reliability for future sourcing decisions. • Generate Local Purchase Orders (LPOs) and procurement documentation using MPSL's standard templates, ensuring accuracy of quantities, rates, and specifications. 4. Estimation & Cost Control • Prepare material cost estimates and pricing schedules for tenders, variations, and value- engineering (VE) proposals. • Maintain and update price trackers, material trackers, and BOQ-vs-order tracking tools to prevent over-ordering and control project costs. • Support Value Engineering exercises (e.g., alternative equipment configurations, 'or-equal' substitutions) with clear technical and cost justification. 5. Procurement & Commercial Skills • 2-3 years of hands-on experience in electrical procurement and/or estimation, preferably within an MEP contracting or construction environment. • Demonstrated experience preparing vendor comparisons, negotiating pricing/terms, and closing purchase orders. • Strong command of MS Excel (formulas, trackers, comparison sheets) and MS Word for technical/commercial documentation. • Good communication skills for vendor negotiation and cross-functional coordination with project teams. Preferred / Added Advantage • Prior exposure to East African market suppliers and import/logistics processes (Kenya, Uganda). • Experience working on institutional/hospital or UN/international-standard projects. • Knowledge of PVOC and other Kenya/Uganda import compliance requirements. Quality Assurance / Operations Reports To: Manager / COO / CEO Employment Type: Full-Time Location: Nairobi (Head Office) with travel to project/client sites Industry: Rope Access (IRATA) Services JOB PURPOSE The Quality Control / Quality Assurance Personnel is responsible for planning, implementing and monitoring quality control and quality assurance processes across the company's rope access operations. The role ensures that all work performed by Team Leaders and Technicians complies with the IRATA International Code of Practice (ICOP), the company's Quality Management System, applicable ISO standards, client specifications, and relevant regulatory requirements, and works closely with Operations and HSE to maintain consistent, auditable quality and safety standards across all projects. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Develop, implement and maintain the company's Quality Management System (QMS) in line with ISO 9001 (or equivalent) and IRATA ICOP requirements. Conduct regular quality audits and site inspections of rope access work and completed tasks to verify compliance with client specifications. Inspect, verify and certify PPE and rope access equipment in line with manufacturer and IRATA requirements; maintain equipment inspection and calibration registers. Cross-check Team Leader and Technician compliance against weekly management feedback reviews, IRATA logbooks and competency records. Investigate non-conformances, incidents and client complaints; lead root-cause analysis and corrective and preventive action (CAPA) processes. Prepare and maintain quality documentation, including SOPs, inspection checklists, audit reports and non-conformance reports (NCRs). Liaise with clients, IRATA, certification bodies and regulatory authorities during audits, inspections and certification renewals. Track and report quality KPIs (e.g. audit pass rates, non-conformance trends, rework rates) to senior management. Support recruitment and onboarding by verifying candidate certifications, licences and competency records before deployment to site. Maintain accurate document control and record-keeping for all quality-related certifications, licences and permits. Coordinate with HSE personnel to align quality and safety compliance programmes. Keep up to date with evolving IRATA standards, ISO requirements and applicable national and international regulatory changes. QUALIFICATIONS & CERTIFICATIONS Diploma or Degree in Quality Management, Engineering, Occupational Health & Safety, or a related field. Recognised quality control/quality assurance certification required — e.g. ISO 9001 Lead Auditor/Internal Auditor, ASQ Certified Quality Auditor (CQA) or Certified Quality Engineer (CQE), or equivalent. Willing to learn IRATA rope access preferred, given the operational environment. Additional certifications such as NEBOSH, Six Sigma, or other recognised QA/QC or HSE qualifications are an advantage. EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS A minimum of 2–5 years' practical experience in a quality assurance/quality control role, ideally within construction, oil & gas, or industrial services. Demonstrated experience conducting audits, developing and maintaining quality procedures, and ensuring compliance with applicable quality standards and regulatory requirements. Experience working with IRATA member companies or within height-safety environments is highly desirable but not essential. Working familiarity with permit-to-work systems, RAMS and method statements. SKILLS & COMPETENCIES Strong working knowledge of applicable quality standards (e.g. ISO 9001, IRATA ICOP) and relevant regulatory requirements. Excellent attention to detail with strong analytical and root-cause analysis skills. Strong report-writing, documentation and record-keeping skills. Good communication (English, Swahili) and interpersonal skills, able to liaise confidently with technicians, management and clients. Willingness and physical capability to attend project sites for inspections, including height/rope-access environments (appropriate PPE and induction provided). Proficiency in MS Office and familiarity with quality management or document-control software. High level of integrity, independence and objectivity when reporting compliance issues. WORKING CONDITIONS Primarily based at the company head office, with regular travel to project and client sites across Kenya (and regionally, as required). Site visits may involve exposure to industrial, height or confined-space environments; full safety induction and PPE will be provided. Standard office hours apply, with flexibility required to accommodate site audit schedules and project timelines. company: Master Power Systems Limited (MPSL) Business Unit: Solar & Substation EPC Reports To: COO / MD Location: Nairobi, Kenya Geographic Coverage: Kenya, Uganda, Rwanda & Tanzania Travel: Regular travel across project sites and client locations ROLE PURPOSE Master Power Systems Limited (MPSL) is seeking an experienced Head of Solar & Substation Business to lead the growth, delivery and profitability of its Solar and Substation EPC business across East Africa. This is a senior, hands-on leadership role with end-to-end accountability across business development, tendering, project execution, commercial performance and client relationships . The successful candidate will be responsible for winning the right projects at the right commercial terms and ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, to quality and safety standards. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Business Growth & Development Develop and execute the Solar & Substation business growth strategy across Kenya, Uganda, Rwanda and Tanzania. Build and manage a qualified pipeline across utilities, transmission companies, IPPs, development finance/donor programmes and C&I clients. Develop senior relationships with utilities, regulators, consultants, DFIs, EPC partners and key clients. Identify new markets, partnerships, consortiums and JV opportunities. Represent MPSL in client meetings, industry forums, pre-bid meetings and site visits. 2. Tendering & Commercial Management Lead bid/no-bid decisions based on technical feasibility, contract risk, resources, payment terms and expected margins. Direct technical and commercial tender preparation, including specifications, BOQs, estimates, pricing and qualifications. Review and approve estimates before submission, ensuring quantities, rates, logistics, duties, escalation, currency exposure and contingencies are properly considered. Lead post-tender clarifications and commercial negotiations through contract award. Own Business Unit performance across order intake, revenue, gross margin, working capital and cash collection . 3. Project Delivery Provide portfolio-level leadership for Solar and Substation projects, including current and future projects. Lead Project Managers, engineers and site teams to deliver projects within approved budgets and programmes. Monitor physical and financial progress, cost-to-complete, resources and project risks. Drive mobilisation, construction, testing, commissioning, handover and final account closure. Proactively address delays, cost overruns, resource constraints and contractual risks. 4. Contracts, Claims & Cost Control Ensure accurate project budgets, valuations, progress claims and cost forecasts. Identify and pursue variations, extensions of time and contractual claims. Protect the company's position on payment terms, retention, performance security, liquidated damages and other contractual exposures. Support procurement through accurate material requirements, technical specifications and vendor evaluations. 5. Quality, HSE & Compliance Ensure projects meet client specifications, utility standards and applicable industry codes. Enforce MPSL health, safety and environmental standards across all sites. Ensure compliance with regulatory, licensing and client/lender ESG requirements across operating countries. 6. Leadership & Reporting Build and lead a strong technical and commercial Business Unit team. Set clear objectives, manage performance and develop team capability. Provide monthly reporting on pipeline, order intake, project delivery, margin, cash, manpower, HSE and key risks. Maintain high standards of integrity, governance and commercial discipline. TECHNICAL & EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent. Minimum 15 years' experience in EPC delivery of HV substations and transmission lines , including senior responsibility for the full project lifecycle. Demonstrated experience delivering grid-connected, mini-grid or C&I solar PV projects . Proven track record working with East African utilities and donor-funded programmes , such as KETRACO, KPLC, UETCL, REA, TANESCO or equivalent. Proven ability to secure EPC orders , lead tender strategy and negotiate contracts through award. Strong P&L/commercial accountability , including margin management, cost-to-complete forecasting and cash performance. Strong knowledge of contracts, variations, claims and FIDIC or equivalent forms . Experience leading multidisciplinary technical, commercial and project teams. Willingness to travel across East Africa; valid passport and ability to obtain work permits. SYSTEMS & TOOLS Experience with ERP-based project controls, MS Project or Primavera and AutoCAD . Knowledge of PLS-CADD or PVsyst is an advantage. CORE COMPETENCIES We are looking for a leader with: Strong commercial judgement and ability to assess risk-adjusted returns. Proven delivery ownership and project execution discipline. Deep technical understanding of solar, substations and EPC environments. Strong contractual and claims management capability. Leadership maturity and ability to hold teams accountable. Credibility with utilities, clients, consultants and senior stakeholders. High integrity and commitment to governance.

Job Description The Internal Platform is a pivotal foundation that accelerates product development by providing a reliable, scalable, and self-service ecosystem. It supports the entire software lifecycle and is meticulously tailored to meet the organization’s technological needs and strategic direction. The platform enables development teams to operate autonomously in 80% of cases, reducing dependency on the Internal Platform team, and ensuring that compliance, security, and business continuity are integrated across the entire platform - defending general reliability of services, and data integrity. Overall, a platform engineering team plays a critical role in ensuring a company's technology infrastructure is reliable and scalable. The Internal Platform team consists of 34 people including 27 individual contributors 2 Staff Engineers, 4 Engineering Managers and Head of Internal Platform. The team is organized in a way to efficiently address Stakeholders needs. What are the challenges in the team? Platform Security is a team within the Internal Platform. The team is a first point of contact for the Global Security Team. The team is responsible for security and integrity of the underlying infrastructure that supports the organization, safeguarding the platform from potential vulnerabilities, threats, and attacks. Developing and maintaining tools for Global Security in order to deliver vulnerability management platforms for application triaging and continuous compliance The complexity of the Docplanner organization: Docplanner is a complex organization with multiple teams working on various products and services. One of the main challenges for the platform security engineer is to understand and integrate the diverse technology stacks used by different teams. Scalability and reliability of systems: As Docplanner grows and expands, the demand for the technology infrastructure also increases. The platform engineering team must ensure that the systems are designed to handle high traffic, are scalable, and secure Who will you work closely with? Global Security – as the main external stakeholder for security initiatives. You’ll collaborate on platform compliance, risk management, and act as a technical point of contact during escalated incidents such as DDoS or abuse cases. PMS (Practice Management Systems) teams – to audit existing systems, support secure migration to the central platform, and interpret global security and legal requirements in the context of PMS implementations. Core Team within Internal Platform – by consulting on technical compliance, networking standards, and resolving misconfigurations or vulnerabilities detected across platform components. Experience Teams – by providing guidance on infrastructure-related application security topics, secure encryption practices, and collaborating on secure CSP integrations. Legal – to ensure alignment with data protection regulations, encryption standards, and locality requirements. You’ll use their insights to assess and improve the security posture of the platform. How would you be impacting our mission? Making sure that our platform is compliant with the best industry practices and standards for security (ISO27001, C5, SOC2) Help us to introduce security on every step of our platform lifecycle Ability to vigilantly understand and mitigate security threats before they arise Optimize system scalability and cost efficiency Development, monitoring, and maintenance of Kubernetes clusters on several continents. CI / CD development and maintenance. Make sure that all of our services are deployed in a way that makes them highly available. Fixing urgent issues and optimizing performance. Support other team members in their daily work. Qualifications What will help you thrive? At least 5 years of experience related with security Vast experience with container orchestration platforms like Kubernetes and how to secure them (must-have). You know how to maintain, develop policy for security-focused CNI/Service Mesh (eg. Calico, Cilium). You know how to scan for and manage vulnerabilities at scale. You have experience with Hashicorp Vault. You know why and how to use Terraform and popular CI/CD tools. You know about building scalable and secure production HA environments using AWS. You know your ways around network security services eg. AWS WAF/Cloudflare. You are not afraid of developing tools or scripts in Bash or GO to automate work. You can communicate in English (both spoken and written - min. B2 level). You know how to bring people on your side when talking about security and best practices. Let’s talk money A salary adequate to your experience and skills. True flexibility and work-life balance Remote or hybrid work model with or hub in Warsaw; Flexible working hours (fully flexible, as in most cases you only have to be on a couple of meetings weekly); 20/26 days of paid time off (depending on your contract); Additional paid day off on your birthday or work anniversary (you choose what you want to celebrate). Health comes first Private healthcare plan with Signal Iduna for you and subsidized for your family. Multisport card co-financing for you to have access to sports facilities across Poland. Access to iFeel , a technological platform for mental wellness offering online psychological support and counseling. Keep growing with us Free English and Spanish classes. We promote and embrace equal opportunities in our hiring process, and also every day at work. When you apply for our roles you receive equal treatment regardless of age, disabilities, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or parental status, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation or any other dimension of human difference. If you require additional support in your recruitment process, we kindly encourage you to let us know. job_title: Product Director, Practice Management Software (PMS)
job_description: About Docplanner We are the world’s largest healthcare platform. Every month, 100 million patients visit our marketplaces — ZnanyLekarz, Doctoralia, MioDottore, Doktortakvimi, jameda — to find the right doctor and book a visit in real time. We process 20 million bookings a month, serve ~300,000 paying doctors and clinics across 13 countries (and we’re #1 in 12 of them), being profitable while growing ~25% a year. And we’re just getting started. Our mission is to help people live longer, healthier lives — and our 10-year ambition is to support 1 billion patient visits a year by putting AI at the heart of every medical workflow. From Noa, our AI brand for doctors, to a frictionless, empathetic and AI-powered patient experience, we are transforming from a marketplace into the operating system of healthcare. What you’re building Practice Management Software — scheduling, electronic health records, billing, insurance — is how clinics actually function. Get it right, and Docplanner doesn't just help patients find doctors. We become indispensable to every clinic that uses us. Your mandate is to build the best PMS in every market we operate in: one coherent vision, localized to win. As our engineering team drives the technical modularization of our core stack, you'll define the product strategy that turns that foundation into something doctors love and clinics can't imagine working without. This is a rare kind of role. You're not inheriting a finished product — you're shaping what it becomes. What you’ll own Product strategy across all PMS — MyDr, Gipo, Clinic Cloud, Feegow, and our own light-version PMS. One north star, adapted for each country. Making PMS AI-first — embedding Noa natively: AI scribe, AI booking, patient summaries, intelligent scheduling. Every clinic gets superpowers out of the box. The unification journey — partnering closely with the Engineering Director so that modularity doesn't just simplify the stack; it unlocks new product possibilities. A growth engine — designing a lightweight entry product for individuals and small clinics, with a clear, natural path to the full PMS, Noa, and marketplace. The outcomes that matter — doctor and clinic retention, expansion revenue, integrated-doctor growth, new-market launches. A team of product leaders across four countries, plus close collaboration with the PMS business owner, country managers, and the Noa team. Who you are We hire for attributes first. These five define how we work — and how you’ll lead: Exceptional problem-solving mindset. Complexity is something you thrive on daily — five products, +12 countries, dozens of integrations — and turn it into a single, cohesive product vision adapted to each country. AI-first approach. You believe the clinic of the future runs on AI — and you’ll make our PMS the place where doctors feel that smoothly. Always solving their problems and discovering what they could do, or what we could do for them and their patients. Product impact focus. You focus on outcomes — retention, expansion, integrated bookings — and you prioritize effectively to ensure we focus on what truly moves them. Builder leadership. You’ve built products and teams; you know a winning product isn't handed over by engineering — it's co-created, and you make the product–design–engineering partnership the strongest relationship in the building. Founder-level ownership and drive. You take the complex, ambiguous, multi-year mission and own it with full accountability and collaborative focus. What you bring 3+ years leading product at Lead / Director level (must-have) — you’ve owned multi-team product organizations, not just a single squad. Proven track record in B2B SaaS. Experience driving multi-product consolidation. Comfort with regulated environments (healthcare data, GDPR, medical-device software) is a strong plus. Fluent English; Spanish, Polish, Italian or Portuguese are a plus in our multi-local world. What we offer Remote-first within Europe — work from anywhere, with hubs in Warsaw, Barcelona and beyond, and regular team off-sites. A seat at the table: you report directly to our CPTO and shape company strategy, not just a roadmap. Competitive compensation package including a stock option plan — we want you to think and earn like an owner. Real scale, real impact: your decisions reach 100 million patients and hundreds of thousands of doctors every month. A profitable, founder-led company on a clear path from €250M to €1B ARR — the rare combination of rocket-ship growth and solid ground. Ready to build the future of healthcare? If you read this and thought “this is my job” we want to hear from you. Apply with your CV and a short note on the product impact you’re most proud of. Full-time · Remote (PL, ES) · Reports to the Chief Product & Technology Officer (CPTO)
